---
title: "External on Start + Void"
description: "External Worker profiles, sealed artifact qualification, and routing rollback."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

External (`apps/external`) runs on TanStack Start, Vite+ and Void behind
[`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`](/build/devops/start-bridge). Record the live
canonical and apex routing before admitting a production cutover.

## Worker

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | The staging Worker by default, `tuturuuu-external` with `VITE_EXTERNAL_NATIVE_PROFILE=production` |
| Flags | `workers_dev` and `preview_urls` off, `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=1` |
| Routes | none; the hostname is attached at cutover by the release operator |
| Hosts | `external.tuturuuu.com` for both profiles. Production also admits `tuturuuu.com/external`. |

The Worker answers with the bridge error response unless it runs in production
mode, has the `ASSETS` binding, and all four of `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`,
`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` and
`TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET` are present (names only recorded here).
`/api/storage/*` is closed to anonymous ingress and answers `403`. Other `/api/*`
paths forward to `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`).

## Build and artifact

Dispatch `external-cloudflare.yaml` on `main` to build and seal both profiles.
The workflow checks bridge routes, native types and emitted bindings, then runs
workerd acceptance on the original output and a fresh restore. The production
archive is `external-native-<source SHA>-production`; its seal records the
Worker identity, emitted config path and file hashes. Check that the production
restore job passed before using the artifact. CI holds no publication credentials.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `tuturuuu-external` |
| Routes | Canonical subdomain and `tuturuuu.com/external`, operator-attached |
| Static assets binding | `ASSETS` (`dist/client`, `run_worker_first`) |
| Build command | `bun run --cwd apps/external build:cloudflare` with `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://external.tuturuuu.com`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_APP_URL=https://tuturuuu.com` |
| Secrets (names) | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET` |
| Rollback | Record the current provider deployment and routing. For an approved new endpoint, prepare route removal and restore the prior apex route. |
| Data | no database writes and no migrations |

### Switch

1. Record the source SHA, archive digest and live routing preimage.
2. Verify the production Worker and required bindings. Upload the sealed
   version without serving traffic and run the smoke against that version.
3. Attach the approved routes after private acceptance and prepare the watch.

### Smoke

```bash
# Entry route is anonymous 200
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://external.tuturuuu.com/
# Build identity matches the accepted SHA
curl -s https://external.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info
# Closed storage ingress
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://external.tuturuuu.com/api/storage/probe
# Foreign host is refused
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H 'Host: unknown.invalid' https://external.tuturuuu.com/
```

Expected: `200`, the accepted commit, `403`, `404`. The app has no login page of its
own; sign-in belongs to the central app. Repeat the root with a query string,
build-info, asset and storage probes under `https://tuturuuu.com/external`.

### Rollback

- **Triggers:** 5xx above 1% for 5 minutes, any cross-host response, or an
  anonymous storage request that is not refused.
- **Action:** restore the captured routing. For an approved new endpoint,
  remove the new route and restore the former apex destination.
- **Data:** a route rollback changes no stored project data.
- **Stability:** preserve the captured deployment and route configuration
  through the rollback window.
